incidents.body:
We experienced a brief period of degraded API performance on the 29th of January, between 20:47 and 21:25 UTC . Our monitoring systems detected the issue, and the team quickly identified and resolved it.

The service was fully restored, and we’ve taken steps to strengthen safeguards and prevent similar issues in the future. We appreciate your patience while we worked to resolve this.
